description: This file defines the 'aCase' class, a model representing customer support cases within SuiteCRM, including properties, relationships, and methods for handling case data.

classes.name: aCase
classes.description: Represents a customer support case in SuiteCRM, with properties for case details, relationships, and methods for data handling and access control.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the case name as its summary text.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control helper data for list views, determining visibility based on user permissions and ownership.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves related contact relationships when the case is updated.

methods.name: set_case_contact_relationship
methods.description: Associates a contact with the case with a default role.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields such as assigned user names and related account info.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the case.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares case data for list view display, including status, priority, and action links.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a search query for cases based on a search string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets email notification content with case details.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates support for specific interfaces, such as ACL.

methods.name: getEmailSubjectMacro
methods.description: Retrieves the macro used for email subject line parsing.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Fetches account information related to a specific case.
